component.name: Simple File Explorer
component.summary: A small, fast file manager for Wayland

description.p: Simple File Explorer (sfe) is a minimal file manager written in C with GTK3. It covers what a daily file manager needs while staying small and readable.

ul.li: A sidebar with places, bookmarks, drives and a folder tree
Up to three split views, grid or list
Fuzzy search, thumbnails and batch rename
Vim-style keys, a command line and undo
Follows the GTK theme and reloads generated colour schemes instantly

screenshot.caption: Folders, a sidebar with drives and the folder tree

description.p: Lighter on big folders: less memory per file and faster loading, with the same icons.
Fixes: gg scrolls back to the first item from the empty space after the files, and thumbnails come back after reloading there.
Settings → System shows the version, build type and git commit sfe was built from.

Folder covers, a status corner with yank and paste reports, grouped Settings with reset by double-click and the theme's colours, and rename and new folders on the command line. Breaking: the command names deprecated since 1.0.0 and :split close are removed; :mass_rename, :mkdir, :touch and :cd changed; visual mode clears the selection after use.
Sort ascending or descending, saved in the settings, from Settings, the list's column headers, a Sort By menu or the :sort command; every view sorts the same way.
Documentation: how to make Chromium and Electron apps use sfe as their file dialog when the session bus address is not set.

sfe can be the Open / Save dialog of other programs (through xdg-desktop-portal, set in Settings), with the program's file type filters and options, a preview of the selected file, and folder-only and one-file selection where the program asks for it.

File views always end with empty space to right-click for the folder's menu, narrow list views drop columns to keep names readable, the grid selects ranges in reading order, and the sidebar says when no devices are listed.
Mounted drives in the sidebar show how full they are, with the numbers on hover; the system disk is listed too, and a setting limits the list to removable drives.
Fixes two crashes in the command line completion and a view in an unreadable folder (such as /root) that could not be focused or closed.
File icons can follow the theme's colours: folders in the accent colour, or one-colour icons, chosen in Settings with a preview of each style.
